description: This file implements a JSON Web Token (JWT) handling class, including encoding, decoding, signature validation, and payload length calculation, with support for SHA256 HMAC signatures.

classes.name: JSONWebData
classes.description: A JSON container class representing the JWT header with 'typ' and 'alg' fields.

classes.name: JSONWebToken
classes.description: A class for creating, encoding, decoding, and validating JSON Web Tokens with support for SHA256 HMAC signatures.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::JSONWebToken
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JWT with a specified mode, key, and creating the header.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a payload into a JWT token string, including signature if SHA256 mode is used.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token string into payload bytes, verifying signature and validity.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::ValidSignature
methods.description: Validates the signature of a JWT token based on the specified mode.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::PayloadLength
methods.description: Calculates the payload length from a JWT token string.
